flags.reason: The Hero Section guide (3f56271; built for #160 at 93f5870) and its evidence were checked on 26 October 2026 on the v0.1.78-c8526ae build; the installed v0.1.78-dbe0e02 has a different HeroSection.tsx (f594fba at c8526ae, d3efc90 at ace46ca, b2435fe at dbe0e02 and in node_modules), changed by Biscuit’s ace46ca and dbe0e02 for Component Bug #404; InputSearch, IconButton, TextInput and Title are unchanged. Read against the installed source, #404’s 27 October re-tests on ace46ca and dbe0e02, and the guide copy recorded today on the installed build, these sentences no longer hold, and the entry leaves them out: (1) Configuration’s “showSearch removes the whole row, the filter too.”, the Title only caption “showSearch={false} removes the filter too.” and Sources’ “… and disappears with showSearch={false} (all reported).”: showSearch={false} drops only the field; the filter and a filterSlot stay (HeroSection.tsx 203, 231). (2) Configuration’s “… which gets the hero’s modes but not Secondary and Medium, so set them on it.”, Sources’ “a filterSlot doesn’t get the filter’s Secondary Medium”, and the filterSlot caption “Your own button, with Secondary and Medium set on it.” with the modes its example sets: the slot gets Secondary, Medium and Button / Size M under its own modes (15–21, 173–180, 217–218), so those modes only repeat the defaults (and building.md keeps appearance and emphasis modes off slot children). (3) Content’s “but leaving subtitle out shows the word Subtitle.”, Sources’ “Leaving subtitle out shows “Subtitle”, as Storybook’s Without Subtitle story does”, and the end of the first Don’t caption, “… and Subtitle.”: subtitle has no default and an omitted or empty one is hidden (125, 27–29, 182); the copy recorded today shows no “Subtitle”, and the entry quotes that caption only up to “Page Title”. (4) The second Do & Don’t pair, “The filter at its size” / “The button matches the field.” against “A smaller filter” / “Button / Size S shrinks only the filter, not the field beside it.”: the hero re-applies Button / Size M to the filter (177), so Size S on the hero no longer shrinks it. (5) The Left caption “The default: the title lines up with the field.”, Sizing’s “the field takes the width left after the 40 px filter and its 16 px gap” and “Figma insets the row another 8 px”, and Sources’ “the package’s row is flush”: the row is inset 8 px at each side (41, 248), so the field starts 8 px in from the title (title at x 12, field at x 20 in #404’s dbe0e02 re-test). Still open on dbe0e02, and the entry’s gap: the 42 px field, 40 px filter and 50 px title block against Figma’s 44, 42 and 44 (#404 item 4; Biscuit keeps the shared control sizes, Marcin to decide). The guide is updated when Component Bug #404 publishes (the Component Fix flow updates the guide copy a fix changed), then a new Agent pack ticket re-extracts. Added by Claude Code in the overnight run agentpack-r27, for Marcin to confirm. Component Bug #404.

examples.purpose: A searchable list, the guide's In context: the hero heads the Transactions page with its name and scope, a search field that says what it finds and a filter button named for what it filters, and the page's list in its body (a ListGroup of the guide's five transactions, each amount a MoneyValue in the row's trailing). The empty searchValue and the empty handlers stand for the page's own state: the page filters the list as people type and opens its filters on onFilterPress.
examples.jsx:
<Screen>
  <HeroSection
    title="Transactions"
    subtitle="Last 30 days"
    searchPlaceholder="Search transactions"
    filterAccessibilityLabel="Filter transactions"
    searchValue=""
    onSearchChange={(text) => {}}
    onFilterPress={() => {}}
  >
    <ListGroup>
      <ListItem layout="Horizontal" title="Blue Tokai Coffee" supportText="Today, 9:12 am" trailing={<MoneyValue value="240.00" currency="₹" />} onPress={() => {}} />
      <ListItem layout="Horizontal" title="Fresh Mart" supportText="Yesterday" trailing={<MoneyValue value="1,180.50" currency="₹" />} onPress={() => {}} />
      <ListItem layout="Horizontal" title="HP Petrol" supportText="22 Oct" trailing={<MoneyValue value="2,000.00" currency="₹" />} onPress={() => {}} />
      <ListItem layout="Horizontal" title="Coffee Day" supportText="21 Oct" trailing={<MoneyValue value="180.00" currency="₹" />} onPress={() => {}} />
      <ListItem layout="Horizontal" title="Airtel Recharge" supportText="20 Oct" trailing={<MoneyValue value="299.00" currency="₹" />} onPress={() => {}} />
    </ListGroup>
  </HeroSection>
</Screen>

from.quote: The hero heads the Transactions page.

props.name: title
props.description: Headline text rendered by the internal {@link Title}. Default "Page Title", from the component source.

props.name: subtitle
props.description: Optional subtitle shown below the title. Omit to hide it.

props.name: titleTextAlign
props.description: Horizontal alignment of the title/subtitle block. Default "Left", from the component source.

props.name: showTitle
props.description: Whether to render the title block. Ignored when `titleSlot` is provided. Default true, from the component source.

props.name: titleSlot
props.description: Fully replace the default title block. When provided, `title`, `subtitle`, `titleTextAlign`, and `showTitle` are ignored. `modes` cascade into the slot.

props.name: showSearch
props.description: Whether to render the search field. Ignored when `searchSlot` is provided. Does not hide the filter. Default true, from the component source.

props.name: searchValue
props.description: Controlled value for the search input.

props.name: onSearchChange
props.description: Change handler for the search input.

props.name: searchPlaceholder
props.description: Placeholder for the search input. Default "Search", from the component source.

props.name: searchSlot
props.description: Fully replace the search input (the flexible left part of the row). When provided, `searchValue`, `onSearchChange`, and `searchPlaceholder` are ignored. `modes` cascade into the slot.

props.name: showFilter
props.description: Whether to render the trailing filter icon button. Default true, from the component source.

props.name: filterIcon
props.description: Icon name for the filter button (from the icon registry). Default "ic_filter", from the component source.

props.name: onFilterPress
props.description: Press handler for the filter button.

props.name: filterAccessibilityLabel
props.description: Accessibility label for the filter button. Default "Filter", from the component source.

props.name: filterSlot
props.description: Fully replace the trailing filter control. When provided, `filterIcon`, `onFilterPress`, and `showFilter` are ignored. FILTER_BUTTON_MODES (Secondary, Medium, Size M) are merged under the slot's own `modes`.

props.name: children
props.description: A full-width body under the row; the hero's modes cascade into it. Declared: Content rendered in the body area below the search row.

props.name: style
props.description: Style overrides applied to the outer container.
